title: Fast robbers on abelian Cayley graphs and digraphs
summary: We study the fast-robber version of the Cops and Robbers game on finite strongly connected abelian Cayley digraphs, including undirected Cayley graphs as the symmetric case. For bounded out-degree $D$, we show that $c_{1,\infty}\left(Γ\right)=O_D\left(n^{1-\frac{1}{D}}\right)$; in the undirected case with $D\ge2$, this improves to the optimal exponent $1-\frac{1}{\left\lfloor \frac{D}{2}\right\rfloor}$.
